Frequently Asked Questions

Questions CES Exhibitors Ask Us

Do you work with any company?

No. Every company goes through an approval process. One condition is that we only take on companies we're confident we can get CES meetings for.

Do you work with companies outside the US?

Yes. Many of our clients are based outside the US. We handle all the press including US-based media for you, so a language barrier, a time difference, or having no US media contacts is no problem.

Do you guarantee press coverage?

We guarantee meetings with reporters, not coverage. We use our press relationships to get key reporters to review your products then schedule meetings at your booth. We prep you for every interview and give each reporter everything they need to feature your story. Before the show, you'll get a list of your scheduled interview times, so you know exactly who to expect.

How involved do we need to be?

Not much. We do the work for you. We build your online press page, reach out to our press contacts, schedule your appointments, follow up with reporters after each meeting, and send you the analytics so you can see the value of your coverage.

What does it cost?

Plans and pricing are in the free brochure. Request it and we'll send everything over.
